# Input Group

A text input with a button joined to it, both reachable at 200% zoom.

In `library/components/input-group/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

**Root:** `.ac-input-group`

## ARIA

- **the input** — `aria-describedby`
- **the addon button** — `aria-label`
- **a search wrapper** — `role=search`

## Keyboard

- `Tab` — native: the button is a real sibling, so it is its own stop

**States:** invalid, revealed

## Goes wrong when

- the button absolutely positioned over the input, so it swallows clicks meant for the text
- no name on the addon — the same failure as icon-button, with a nicer border
- the button overlapping the text at 200% zoom (SC 1.4.4)
- a reveal toggle that renames itself mid-press, so AT announces a new control

**API:** `AC.createInputGroup(root, options) -> { reveal, element, destroy }`

WCAG 1.3.1 1.4.4 2.5.3 2.5.8 3.3.2 4.1.2 · see also `icon-button`, `text-input`, `field`
